In this case, we have an indeterminate form of type $\frac{\infty }{\infty },$ so applying  L'Hopital's rule yields

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to \infty }\frac{2\sqrt{x}+9x-1}{3x+5} & ={lim}_{x\to \infty }\frac{[2\sqrt{x}+9x-1]^{′}}{[3x+5]^{′}} \\  & ={lim}_{x\to \infty }\frac{(\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}+9)}{3} \\  & =\frac{0+9}{3} \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$
